[DEFINE_WORKER: "Interacts with a Scanner to execute a fixed query protocol: for each of three rows it computes p as one plus the length of the longest prefix 1,2,3,... matchable as a subsequence, records the earliest row with minimum n as ind, and then prints the remaining protocol lines and flushes output." solve]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> in </REF>: Scanner "Scanner connected to the input token stream; tokens are consumed in the exact order described by main_flow."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND For each i from 1 through 17 inclusive, consume one input token with in.next() and print i followed by a space and 100. RESULT stdout]
            [COMMAND For each i from 1 through 68 inclusive, consume one input token with in.next(), print (i % 17) + 1 followed by a space and i, then flush standard output before the next iteration. RESULT stdout]
            [COMMAND Allocate res as a new String[3] array (unused later), num as a new int[3] array, set m to 1000, and set ind to 0. RESULT state]
            [COMMAND For each i from 0 through 2 inclusive, consume one input token with in.next(), print 18 + i followed by a space and 0, read an integer n with in.nextInt(), and set p to 1. RESULT phase3_state]
            [COMMAND Within each phase-3 row, for k from 0 while k < n, read an integer t with in.nextInt(); if t equals p, increment p by 1, otherwise leave p unchanged. RESULT p]
            [COMMAND After the inner loop of each phase-3 row, if n is less than m, set m to n and set ind to i, otherwise leave m and ind unchanged; then assign num[i] to the final value of p. RESULT m, ind, num]
            [COMMAND For each outer repetition i from 0 through 3 inclusive, for each j from 0 through 2 inclusive: if j is not equal to ind, consume one input token with in.next() and print 18 + j followed by a space and num[j]; otherwise consume no token and print nothing. RESULT stdout]
            [COMMAND Consume one input token with in.next(), print the literal string 19 0, then read an integer n with in.nextInt(). RESULT n]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 while i < n, consume one input token with in.next() and discard it. RESULT void]
            [COMMAND For each i from 18 through 20 inclusive, consume one input token with in.next() and print i followed by a space and 100. RESULT stdout]
            [COMMAND Flush standard output with System.out.flush(). RESULT stdout]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
